method: 100 new first-attempt production UI questions on unchanged known synthetic fixtures. Strict manual grading: pass only if every material requested fact, subject, uncertainty, format and safety requirement holds. Partial and technical errors count against strict pass rate. No retry replaces a first attempt; no code changes during run. Five follow-up pairs. Not a blinded external assessment or unseen-user generalization.
accountPlan: Effective Plus QA, five-year access. Free-tier performance is not measured by this UI run.
